svg.aria-label: Each column follows one test image: original, 2D AE, 8D AE, β=1 VAE mean-code reconstruction, noisy input, and 8D denoising AE. One intensity scale, 0–1, is used throughout. Data: E. Alpaydin, C. Kaynak, UCI handwritten digits, CC BY 4.0. Reconstructions are measured model outputs.
